findings.desc: Stale docs still describe advisory auto-promotion as future/default-off/feature-flag gated instead of the B-7ee1 evidence-activated apply path. In playbook-promotion-worker-execution-plan.md, the status/summary and V1 activation paragraphs still say candidate-to-active mutation remains future work or behind an explicit feature flag (for example lines 3-5, 33-34, 137-141, and 665-666), while the new section says evidence-activated promotion is not controlled by a default-off ordinary-use flag. In source-lineage-dedup-playbook-seed-promotion-execution-plan.md, the updated M8 section is correct, but acceptance/safety text still says automatic advisory activation is disabled by default or requires an explicit feature flag (lines 485-486 and 525-527). This leaves the touched decision docs internally inconsistent with the intended boundary: promotion sweep only recommends; separate playbook_auto_promotion_apply may activate only after reviewed policy, current digest, applied recommend_activate decision, explicit exposure/outcome evidence, clean lineage, and rollback readiness, while remaining non-authoritative and non-gate evidence.

Evidence-activation smoke is not wired into the routine test surfaces: neither packages/main/package.json nor packages/main/smoke-manifest.json references playbook-evidence-activation-smoke or the delegated playbook-seed-promotion-loop smoke, so the new coverage can be skipped by normal package smoke commands/run-all-smokes despite the file existing.

M8 coverage does not exercise the fail-closed path where a candidate has enough real helped/exposure outcomes to evaluate as recommend_activate but no applied recommend_activate decision row exists. The smoke records three helped outcomes and immediately runs playbook_promotion_sweep before calling playbook_auto_promotion_apply, so a regression that activated on outcomes alone would not be caught. The same block also only checks second-apply idempotency after the playbook is already active, not the digest-bound activation idempotency/audit key branch for an already-recorded activation row while the candidate remains candidate.
